_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 30d momentum and funding pinned near neutral with rangebound price action make HOLD the base-rate coil call; no impulse breaker is visible yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD coil toward Complacency (illegal rung); narrative is descriptive inflow drop only, silent on forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, 30d momentum near 50, funding flat, fear_greed roughly 50-62
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum_30d through ~70 with funding heat, or downside break with fear_greed under ~45 and VIX expansion
